baseline_models.focus_anchor: The vocative sister-address and the paired father and mother clauses at words 1, 5, and 10.
baseline_models.mechanism: The address places Mary inside a horizontal and vertical kinship frame, while the two negated past predicates turn household character into the precedent against which she is measured.

activation_trace.role: Sibling kinship supplies the horizontal family link used to identify and evaluate Mary.
Paternity and upbringing supply a paternal precedent for the household's expected character.
Maternity and nurture supply the corresponding maternal precedent.
The two past states make established family history function as evidence in the present encounter.

changed_reading.before: The verse separately mentions three relatives.
changed_reading.after: The crowd constructs a household norm across sibling, father, and mother and treats Mary's apparent anomaly as a breach of that inherited pattern.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The parallel negations contrast a father who was not a man of badness with a mother who was not sexually transgressive.
baseline_models.mechanism: Syntactic balance conceals a gendered asymmetry: broad defective character is denied of the father, while a specific sexual charge is denied of the mother. The parental praise therefore operates as indirect prosecution of the daughter.

activation_trace.role: The human male designation fixes the paternal side of the comparison as a general character judgment.
General ugliness or bad quality supplies the broad paternal category.
Defect-finding turns the ostensibly descriptive comparison into an act of censure.
The sexual-transgression branch specifies the narrower maternal category implicitly transferred to Mary.

changed_reading.before: The parents receive two equivalent compliments.
changed_reading.after: The parallel clauses form an asymmetric moral ledger whose praise of the parents is evidence for a sexualized indictment of their daughter.

baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside ordinary sibling reference, the root's binding image lets the sister-address act as a social tether: the speaker fastens Mary to a named affiliation and its obligations before stating the charge.

activation_trace.role: A fastening bond makes the vocative function as an obligation-bearing tie, not merely a genealogical label.

changed_reading.before: The sister-address only locates Mary in a genealogy.
changed_reading.after: The address may also rhetorically bind her to an affiliation whose reputation is being enforced.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mary first denies both human contact and being sexually transgressive; the crowd later repeats the same transgression term through her mother. Her first-person account is thus revoiced as a hereditary test that ignores the no-contact premise.

activation_trace.role: Sexual contact is explicitly negated, supplying the causal premise the later accusation fails to accommodate.
Skin-to-skin contact sharpens the denied ordinary human mechanism of conception.
Mary's own denial supplies the exact sexual charge later echoed through maternal precedent.
The mother relation redirects Mary's self-description into a comparison with her maternal line.
The repeated sexual category closes the echo and makes the redirection accusatory.

structural_cues: The same root and nominal charge occur at 19:20 and 19:28.
The voice shifts from Mary's first-person denial to the crowd's second-person family comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact recurrence and the prior no-contact denial; I infer that the later wording revoices and discounts Mary's account. A live alternative is ordinary repetition of a shared moral category without deliberate echo.

changed_reading.before: The maternal clause is a generic family comparison.
changed_reading.after: It is also a hostile reformulation of Mary's own earlier chastity claim, moved from direct testimony to inherited plausibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pregnancy is declared a manifest sign, mercy, and completed determination, but the community encounters only Mary visibly carrying the child. It classifies the visible result through ordinary moral causation as badness and sexual transgression.

activation_trace.role: A manifest marker supplies the event's disclosed category as a sign rather than an offense.
Merciful tenderness supplies the event's intended beneficial valence.
Effectuated completion supplies a hidden causal determination independent of the crowd's inference.
The visibly borne child supplies the public surface from which the community reasons.
Bad quality is the community's replacement category for the sign.
Sexual wrongdoing supplies the ordinary cause inferred from the visible child.

structural_cues: 19:21 names the event before 19:27 makes its result public.
The crowd has the visible child but not the narrated causal disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sign, mercy, determination, and visible carrying; I supply the arrow that the crowd substitutes ordinary sexual causation for hidden causation. They could alternatively be reacting socially without a worked-out causal model.

changed_reading.before: The verse is simply a moral reproach.
changed_reading.after: The reproach dramatizes a category error: a merciful sign is read from its public surface as inherited shame and sexual offense.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mary moves aside from her family, places a barrier, withdraws again, and then returns to her people. The sister-father-mother address is the community's verbal reversal of that spatial separation: it pulls her back under household classification and communal jurisdiction.

activation_trace.role: Movement to one side initiates separation from the kinship setting.
The near group of belonging supplies the social body from which she withdraws.
A screening barrier intensifies the spatial and social separation.
The repeated movement aside extends withdrawal through the pregnancy.
The assembled people provide the public jurisdiction to which she returns.
Sibling identification verbally reattaches Mary to the family network.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from family separation through a barrier and distant withdrawal to public return.
The crowd answers spatial return with three kinship labels.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the withdrawal-return sequence and kin terms; I infer that naming kin reasserts communal authority over Mary. A softer alternative is that the family references express shocked familiarity rather than jurisdiction.

changed_reading.before: The kin terms merely explain who Mary is.
changed_reading.after: They perform social reattachment after seclusion, reclaiming her as a household member precisely in order to police the household norm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope commands Mary's remembrance in the Book; under labor she wishes to have become a discarded forgotten thing; the crowd then remembers her through sibling and parental reputation. The focus verse becomes an anti-oblivion scene whose first human form is punitive memory.

activation_trace.role: Recall after absence establishes remembrance as the frame of the episode.
Public repute turns remembrance into a question of Mary's social name.
Registration in a record supplies the durable public-memory pole.
The discarded forgotten object supplies Mary's desired escape from social memory.
The father reference recalls Mary through inherited household reputation.
The mother reference completes the crowd's genealogical act of remembrance.

structural_cues: The opening remembrance command precedes Mary's doubled wish for oblivion.
The focus verse recalls no personal act by Mary but recites her family record.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembrance, record, desired oblivion, and genealogical recall; I infer a contrast between canonical remembrance and punitive communal memory. The alternatives are independent motifs of narration, despair, and family comparison.

changed_reading.before: The crowd cites family facts while Mary is publicly present.
changed_reading.after: Their accusation is a coercive mode of remembering her, restoring the very social identity from which she had wished to disappear.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mary has undertaken restraint of speech, so the crowd's paired parental claims occupy the unanswered space. Her gesture transfers the reply to the child, whose speech follows; the focus verse is therefore a prosecution temporarily uncontested, not the scene's final account.

activation_trace.role: Restraint of the tongue creates the speech vacuum in which the accusation lands.
Intelligible exchange is explicitly withheld, blocking Mary's direct rebuttal.
A bodily indication redirects attention and delegates the response.
The child's voiced statement supplies the delayed counter-speech.
The crowd fills Mary's silence with asserted past states about her family.

structural_cues: The instruction not to speak precedes the accusation.
Mary answers by pointing, and the child's speech immediately follows.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withheld speech, accusation, gesture, and child speech; I infer a delegated evidentiary reply. The gesture could instead merely identify the child without functioning as a formal answer.

changed_reading.before: The verse states the crowd's settled verdict.
changed_reading.after: It is the loudest claim in a deliberately one-sided interval, framed for displacement by a nonverbal gesture and an unexpected witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The crowd tests Mary backward through her parents; the child answers forward as her descendant, naming stable good, filial goodness to his mother, and the absence of coercive wretchedness. Moral evidence changes direction across the generations.

activation_trace.role: Stable growing good supplies the child's positive character evidence.
Filial beneficence makes his relation to his mother direct countertestimony about the new household.
Parenthood by birth reverses the focus verse's backward lineage test toward Mary as mother.
Negated coercive domination supplies a specific denial of bad character in the child.
Negated wretchedness completes the descendant's contrary moral profile.
The maternal relation is the hinge between the crowd's ancestral comparison and the child's filial testimony.

structural_cues: 19:28 reasons from Mary's parents toward Mary.
19:31-32 reasons from Mary's child back toward his mother.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed generational relations and moral predicates; I infer that the child's profile answers the crowd's lineage test by reversing its direction. It may also function independently as self-description rather than rebuttal.

changed_reading.before: Mary appears as a defective exception to an upright ancestral household.
changed_reading.after: The next generation supplies counter-evidence: Mary becomes the mother toward whom a blessed and dutiful child defines himself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus verse twice reasons with past being: neither parent was such a person. Later the same root spans a negated formula and the command-result sequence of becoming. Family precedent remains socially intelligible but loses force as a proof against unprecedented creation.

activation_trace.role: Two established past states make inherited history the crowd's evidentiary grammar.
Negated being followed by commanded and realized becoming supplies the grammar of causally unprecedented emergence.
Effective determination supplies the causal bridge from command to realized event.
A spoken command contrasts with the crowd's spoken inference and produces rather than merely judges a state.

structural_cues: The focus repeats the negated past formula.
19:35 contains the same root in past negation, imperative command, and resulting present form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the concentrated root and form recurrence; I infer an antithesis between precedent-based judgment and creative becoming. A live alternative is that the repeated root serves local syntax without retrospectively correcting the crowd's logic.

changed_reading.before: The parents' past character makes Mary's situation seem impossible within family history.
changed_reading.after: The verse exposes the limit of reasoning from what has been: unprecedented becoming can be effected without falsifying the family's prior moral record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The crowd names Mary backward through Aaron, father, and mother; the later declaration names Jesus forward through Mary and marks that naming as truth amid dispute. The accused woman becomes the lineage anchor.

activation_trace.role: Descent from an origin makes Mary, rather than her ancestors, the identifying source of the new lineage.
An explicit assertion sets the later identification against the crowd's earlier speech.
Truth matching reality validates the maternal naming against accusatory appearance.
Contentious disputation preserves the social conflict around that validated identity.
The initial sibling naming identifies Mary by an older lateral relation.
The paternal reference supplies the backward direction of the crowd's lineage logic.

structural_cues: 19:28 identifies Mary through prior family relations.
19:34 identifies the child through Mary and explicitly places the statement amid dispute.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the inverse naming formulas and truth-dispute frame; I infer a restoration of Mary as a lineage source. The later naming may identify Jesus without intending a direct reversal of the crowd's rhetoric.

changed_reading.before: Mary is only the endpoint of inherited family reputation.
changed_reading.after: The accusation stands at a generational pivot: the woman named through ancestors becomes the mother through whom the child is truthfully named.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a juridical branch from the adjective describing ripe fruit and then maps fruit-source imagery onto childbirth. It remains anchored in the focus verse's maternal sexual charge and in the immediate birth sequence, but downstream prose should present it only as a cross-domain lexical shadow, never as the surface meaning of the date-fruit phrase.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The mother relation and the sexual-transgression term at words 10-11.

activation_trace.role: Taking produce from its source supplies a nearby material image of visible fruit and origin.
Imputing guilt to an innocent person casts an anticipatory juridical shadow over the later accusation.
Maternity anchors the source-to-offspring transfer in the focus verse.
The sexual allegation supplies the actual imputed guilt to which the fruit branch is abductively connected.

changed_reading.before: The dates are only material relief before the confrontation.
changed_reading.after: Their gathered-fruit root may faintly prefigure the crowd treating the child as visible produce from which guilt is wrongly inferred about its maternal source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reflexively applies the focus verse's badness term to the speakers' own utterance. It remains anchored in that exact term and is activated by the sequence from relieved grief to withheld speech and wound-like speech, but downstream prose should qualify it as rhetorical irony rather than an asserted judgment of speaker intent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The badness term at word 7, especially its distress and defect-finding branches.

activation_trace.role: Inner roughness from grief supplies the affective harm from which Mary had just been reassured.
Settling the eye supplies the immediately preceding movement toward composure.
The root's bodily wound image lets surrounding speech register as an injurious mark.
What causes distress makes the accusation itself a possible instance of the badness it invokes.
Defect-finding names the speakers' rhetorical act while they deny that quality of Mary's father.

changed_reading.before: Badness is only a character category denied of Mary's father.
changed_reading.after: The accusation may ironically perform distressing defect-finding, enacting one branch of the very badness from which the father is cleared.

strongest_changes: Mary's earlier first-person chastity denial is revoiced as a maternal lineage test.
A declared sign and mercy is misclassified from its visible surface as sexual wrongdoing.
The child's filial testimony reverses the crowd's backward ancestral test.
The double past-state formula is relativized by the later command and realization of unprecedented becoming.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse is a compact social tribunal built from kinship and past precedent, but the surrounding sequence repeatedly reverses its evidentiary direction: withdrawal becomes forced reattachment, silence delegates reply, ancestors give way to a descendant, and inherited being gives way to created becoming.
remaining_uncertainties: The sister-address can carry binding affiliation, but the packet alone does not settle the exact historical relation intended.
The echo of the sexual-transgression term is structurally strong, while deliberate quotation by the crowd remains inferential.
The fruit-guilt and reflexive-badness activations are validly anchored but intentionally exploratory and should not be rendered as lexical equivalences.
